sloka: स तम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा पृष्ट्वा चैव निरामयम् ।पितृइन् स परिपप्रच्छ वाजि हर्तारम् एव च ॥१-४१-८॥
transliteration: sa tam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā pṛṣṭvā caiva nirāmayam ।pitṛin sa paripapraccha vāji hartāram eva ca ॥1-41-8॥

translations.english: Having circumambulated the elephant, he (Anshuman) enquired about his wellbeing, the where abouts of his uncles and also about the one who had stolen the sacrificial horse.
